title: How Game Developers use 3D AI Studio to make 3D Models for their Game
author: Historical-Boat-4101

comments.author: yarsvet
comments.body: It's a fake ads video. They always get a cool result in a promotion video. From my experience (I've generated hundreds of ai 3d meshes) the first place is TripoAi and Rodin by quality + both allow to generate for free at least some amount from a free acc. The second place is Luma Ai because it generates fast and free but quality not so good. Other services like Meshy Ai and others are just meh

replies.author: yarsvet
replies.body: I have your site in my browser history. I've tried to use it in the past but there are no free generations. You can't expect people to just believe your ads videos. You could just add preview mode where people can generate several meshes without downloading it if you don't want they to abuse free acc. Also your "3d library" tab looks suspicious because it has only 21 pages. Tripo and Luma have literally thousands of other users' generations I can look at.

replies.body: So I found your site before finding this thread. Signed up, tried to give it a good try and everything I tried was "hey you've found a premium feature". I still can't find where you've hidden these free trial generations. It's all well and good having cherry picked 3D models to look at but I don't know how many credits people used to generate those. I need to know how the generation process looks and that I'm not going to be using all of my monthly credits just tweaking a single model to get it right.
